urdu transliteration: Kya raha khaimo may Sheh ke ik udasi reh gayi (x2)
english translation text: Nothing remained in the tents of the Imam except sorrow.

urdu transliteration: Kiya raha khaimon may Sheh kay ik udasi reh gayee (x2) Sirf Ronay ko Mohammed ki nawasi reh gayee
english translation text:
Nothing remained in the tents of the Imam except sorrow.
Only the granddaughter of Muhammad was left to weep.

urdu transliteration: 1. Cheen ta tha Shimr chadar aur Zainab baar baar (x2) Apni chadar ke muhafiz ko bulati reh gayee
english translation text:
Shimr was snatching away Zainab's veil,
While she repeatedly called upon the protector of her chador.

urdu transliteration: 2.Khoon-e-dil Abbas kaa sub beh gayaa run may magar (x2) Dil main bus ek baat Zainab ki rida ki reh gayee
english translation text:
Abbas shed all of his blood upon the battlefield,
Yet one concern remained within his heart: Zainab's veil.

urdu transliteration: 3.Ay Musalmano tumhari ghayratain kya ho gayee(x2) Tum tamashayee thay Zainab muh chupati reh gayee
english translation text:
O Muslims! What became of your honour and dignity?
You stood as spectators while Zainab tried to cover her face.

urdu transliteration: 4 Qaid main Baali Sakina ko mila baba ka sur (x2) Mu pe mu rakh kar jo soyee maa jagati reh gayee
english translation text:
In prison, little Sakina was given her father's severed head.
She fell asleep with face upon face, while her mother kept trying to wake her.

urdu transliteration: 5. Maadar-e-Asgher na baithi saaye main Asgher kay baad (x2) Saaye main aayi to zinda laash baqi reh gayee
english translation text:
After the martyrdom of Asghar, his mother never sat in the shade.
And when she finally did, only a living corpse remained.

urdu transliteration: 6. Har tamachay par Sakina mu pay rakh kar nanne haath (x2) Neel rukhsaaron kay Ghazi ko dikhaati reh gayee
english translation text:
With every slap, Sakina raised her tiny hands to her face,
Showing her bruised cheeks to Ghazi Abbas.
